q_001.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer:
**Top 5 Best‑Selling Genres (by total sales)**  

| Rank | Genre                | Total Sales (USD) |
|------|----------------------|-------------------|
| 1    | Rock                 | $826.65 |
| 2    | Latin                | $382.14 |
| 3    | Metal                | $261.36 |
| 4    | Alternative & Punk  | $241.56 |
| 5    | TV Shows             | $93.53 |

These figures represent the sum of `UnitPrice × Quantity` for all invoice lines belonging to tracks in each genre.

q_004.sql:
SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
ORDER BY track_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_004.answer: The most popular media type, based on the number of tracks, is **“MPEG audio file”** (MediaTypeId = 1) with **3,034 tracks**.

q_005.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1;
q_005.answer: The employee with the most customers assigned is **Jane Peacock** (EmployeeId 3), who has **21 customers**.

q_009.sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, IFNULL(SUM(i.Total),0) AS TotalSpending,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY IFNULL(SUM(i.Total),0) DESC) AS Rank
  FROM Customer c
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
) 
ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_009.answer:
**Top 5 customers by total spending**

| Rank | Customer Id | First Name | Last Name | Total Spending (USD) |
|------|-------------|------------|-----------|----------------------|
| 1 | 6 | Helena | Holý | **49.62** |
| 2 | 26 | Richard | Cunningham | **47.62** |
| 3 | 57 | Luis | Rojas | **46.62** |
| 4 | 45 | Ladislav | Kovács | **45.62** |
| 4 | 46 | Hugh | O'Reilly | **45.62** |

*The ranking uses a **dense rank** – customers with the same spending receive the same rank, and the next rank skips the duplicate (hence two customers share rank 4).*

q_010.sql:
SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS GenreCount
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
ORDER BY GenreCount DESC, ArtistName;
